verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is an LLM inference API, and a buyer could fairly ask whether it can be operated by natural-language commands, for example managing keys, endpoints or billing through a conversational or agentic interface. The pack documents a model playground, SDKs and a Cloud Console for projects, keys, usage and team access. None of these is shown to accept natural-language commands to operate the product; prompting a hosted model is using its output, not commanding the service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
